segments.caption: This is Alpine. A mock interview you answer out loud.

segments.label: Alpine
segments.caption: It shows you exactly where an answer fell apart, and gives you a better next take.

segments.label: 1 · The job
segments.caption: Start with the job. Pick a role, add the company, and paste the posting.

segments.label: 2 · The facts
segments.caption: Alpine researches the company. You keep only the facts that are right.

segments.label: 3 · The interview
segments.caption: Then the interview starts. Answer by voice, or type. A vague answer gets a follow-up, built from your own words.

segments.label: 3 · The interview
segments.caption: Specific answers move you on. End the session whenever you are done.

segments.label: 4 · The report
segments.caption: Every take is graded on six dimensions. Each score quotes what you said, with one thing to fix. Replay it, or download it as a PDF.

segments.label: 5 · Your climb
segments.caption: The overview tracks your progress: scores per take, filler words, and how far you have climbed.
Alpine. Rehearse the interview. Then just show up.
